uncited: **Tetrahedral Mesh Textures:** The tetrahedral mesh data structure is stored in a set of textures.
**Pre-integration Table:** A 3D texture (or set of textures) storing pre-computed ray integral results.
Iterate over all possible combinations of entry scalar value $s^{(f)}$, exit scalar value $s^{(b)}$, and thickness $l$.
For each pixel, cast a ray through the scene.
Intersect the ray with the tetrahedral mesh.
Determine the entry point and exit point of the ray within the tetrahedron.
Calculate the thickness $l$ as the distance between the entry and exit points.
Composite the fetched color and opacity into the ray accumulator using standard volume rendering blending equations.
Repeat for all intersected tetrahedra until the ray exits the volume or is fully opaque.
